name: alerts_list
description: Evaluate and report active system alerts including critical quota thresholds (<=5%), sudden quota drops, and dead headless processes.

profile.description: Optional profile name to inspect (or omit to inspect all profiles).

name: dispatch_cancel
description: Cancel a currently running dispatched task.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to cancel.

name: dispatch_list
description: List dispatched tasks with optional filters by status, profile, or repository.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 20).

name: dispatch_logs
description: Retrieve terminal logs and output from a dispatched task.

tail.description: Number of tail lines or bytes to retrieve (default 10000, 0 for all).

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task.

name: dispatch_plan
description: Execute a multi-agent execution plan with concurrent subtasks across isolated Git worktrees, aggregating diffs and validating disjoint scopes.

base_branch.description: Base branch to fork ephemeral worktrees from.

base_commit.description: Base commit hash to fork ephemeral worktrees from.

plan_id.description: Optional custom plan identifier. Auto-generated if omitted.

repo.description: Path to target Git repository. Defaults to current working directory.

subtasks.description: List of subtask specifications to execute in parallel worktrees.

branch.description: Custom branch name for this subtask's worktree.

command.description: Custom command or script to execute inside the worktree.

env.description: Environment variables map for this subtask.

profile.description: Target Antigravity profile for identity, quota, and credential isolation.

prompt.description: Prompt instruction for the worker agent.

workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker tasks executing simultaneously (default 4).

name: dispatch_status
description: Get detailed execution status, runtime duration, exit code, and worktree info of a dispatched task.

repo.description: Optional path to the Git repository containing the task.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task.

name: dispatch_subagent
description: Delegate an autonomous subagent prompt directly to an Antigravity worker using headless CLI invocation (agy -p / cascade) with quota-aware multi-profile routing and automatic failover.

auto_failover.description: Automatically fail over to secondary candidate profiles if the primary hits rate limits or quota exhaustion (default true).

dangerously_skip_permissions.description: Bypass interactive confirmation prompts in headless mode (default true).

disable_slash_commands.description: Disable interactive slash commands in headless execution (default true).

effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the model: 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

env.description: Custom environment variables to pass to the subagent session.

max_failovers.description: Maximum number of secondary profile failovers to attempt (default 3).

model.description: Target model for execution and quota routing (e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash', 'gemini-3.8-pro', 'claude-3-7-sonnet').

profile.description: Antigravity profile name for execution, or 'auto' for dynamic quota-aware routing (default 'auto').

prompt.description: Subagent task prompt or instruction to execute autonomously.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for log and token correlation.

weight.description: Task weight for quota threshold evaluation: 'light', 'medium', or 'heavy' (default 'medium').

name: dispatch_task
description: Dispatch an agent command or script within an isolated Git worktree or specified repository using a dedicated Antigravity profile.

args.description: Command arguments array. If provided, overrides automatic argument resolution.

auto_spawn_headless.description: Automatically awaken inactive profiles with on-demand headless server if needed.

background.description: Whether to dispatch detached in background and return immediately with the task ID (default false).

branch.description: Branch name to create or use inside an isolated Git worktree.

command.description: Command or agent instruction to execute (e.g., 'claude -p "fix bug"' or shell script).

env.description: Custom environment variables key-value map to pass into the task session.

governance.description: Inject project governance directives (AGENTS.md, TASK.md) into agent prompt and environment (defaults to false for MCP dispatch).

headless.description: Execute task in headless agent mode.

model.description: Target model for quota-aware routing when profile is 'auto' (e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash', 'claude-3-7-sonnet').

probe.description: Whether to probe and awaken inactive secondary profiles when profile is 'auto' (default false).

profile.description: Antigravity profile name for identity and credentials isolation (e.g. 'yegear', 'yegear2'), or 'auto' to dynamically route to the profile with the healthiest quota.

prompt.description: Prompt instruction for the agent command (e.g. passed as -p to agy or claude if args is not provided).

read_only.description: Enforce strict read-only execution guard preventing file modifications.

repo.description: Path to target Git repository. Defaults to current directory or detected active workspace.

retry.description: Maximum number of retries if verification fails (default 0).

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait when wait is true (default 120).

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier (or MAESTRI_TRACE_ID) for VictoriaLogs token delta correlation.

verify.description: Verification command to execute inside worktree upon agent completion (e.g. 'go test ./...'). If non-zero exit code, marks task audit_failed.

wait.description: Wait synchronously for task execution to reach terminal status before returning result (default false).

weight.description: Task weight for quota routing thresholds when profile is 'auto': 'light', 'medium', or 'heavy' (default 'medium').

workspace.description: Workspace isolation mode: 'worktree' (isolated Git worktree), 'mirror' (lightweight mirror), or 'inherit' (zero-I/O in-place).

worktree.description: Custom worktree path or reuse identifier. If empty and branch is given, an ephemeral worktree is created.

name: doctor_diagnose
description: Run Multigravity Doctor diagnostics to check IDE installations, language servers, toolchains, and environment health.

name: prime_status
description: Check AI quota priming status, scheduled watchdog timers, and last primed timestamps for profiles.

name: prime_trigger
description: Trigger proactive quota priming or 5-hour window warm-up for one or all profiles.

check.description: Dry-run check: verify if profiles can be primed without sending actual prompts.

force.description: Force priming regardless of quota percentage or reset timing.

profile.description: Profile name to prime (omit to prime all eligible profiles).

warm_5h.description: Proactively send a minimal 1-token prompt to start the rolling 5-hour window countdown.

name: profile_list
description: List all Antigravity profiles with their execution state, running PID, ports, disk usage, and authentication mode.

name: profile_status
description: Retrieve detailed status, storage metrics, and sharing configurations for a specific Antigravity profile.

name: quota_history
description: Retrieve historical time-series of quota percentages and token consumption for one or all profiles.

limit.description: Maximum number of history points to return (default 50).

profile.description: Profile name (if omitted, aggregates history across all profiles).

name: quota_summary
description: Query live AI quota limits (5-hour sliding window and weekly limits, percentage remaining, reset countdown) from running Language Servers.

profile.description: Optional target profile name. If omitted, queries all active profiles.

name: task_diff
description: Inspect the Git diff generated by a dispatched task within its isolated worktree. Returns summary, changed files, hunks, or unified diff.

structured.description: Return structured JSON containing changed files, hunks, line additions and deletions (default true).

task_id.description: The unique ID of the dispatched task.

name: workspace_list
description: List detected project workspaces and active Git repositories across Antigravity profiles.

active_only.description: When true, returns only currently active workspaces in running profiles.

name: worktree_diff
description: Inspect the Git diff of a specific ephemeral worktree compared against its base branch or commit.

repo.description: Path to the base Git repository.

worktree_id.description: The ID of the worktree to inspect.
